text: AI is changing how we think about creativity. Today, computers can create art, compose music, and even write stories. These tools learn from huge amounts of data and then produce something new. But is this real creativity? Humans create from emotions, personal experiences, and imagination. A machine follows patterns and rules. AI can help artists and writers save time or find fresh ideas, but it cannot feel joy, sadness, or wonder. So perhaps the best result comes when humans and machines work together, using technology as a tool rather than a replacement.
